packageRules.description: Action pins are SHAs. Renovate reads the adjacent version comment to know what the SHA currently is, and rewrites both together.
The Go toolchain moves as one. go.mod, both workflows and the toolchain directive have to agree, or a clean local run stops predicting a clean CI run.

customManagers.description: The Go version both workflows install. Native managers do not read setup-go's input, so without this the CI toolchain silently diverges from go.mod.

golangci-lint's own version, which is an input to the action rather than the action's tag. Pinned to what Homebrew ships so a clean local run means a clean CI run — and that only holds while something watches it.
govulncheck, pinned in a `go run` line. No manager reads an inline module@version in a shell command.
zizmor, pinned in the pip install that provides the workflow audit. An unwatched security gate is one that stops catching what its newer rules would.
goreleaser's own version constraint, an input to the action rather than its tag.
